current.text: Charlotte took him 14th overall in the 2026 draft. This is his rookie season.
He is projected to come off the bench. Reid and Diabaté are the projected frontcourt starters, and he is next in line behind them.
He competes with Diabaté and Kalkbrenner for center minutes. Charlotte's center plan is not settled.
Charlotte is expected to use a three-center rotation and to play Grant Williams as a small-ball five. He probably will not get close to 30 minutes.
Some people are talking about starting him, and one expert sees a path to a starting role soon.
Charlotte did not let him shoot threes in Summer League. Last season the team also did not let Kalkbrenner shoot threes.
Draft value: a stash in deep leagues only. He becomes a pick in all leagues if he is named a starter.

durable.text: He was the best rebounder in college basketball, and his rebounding carried over to Summer League.
Experts call him a monster, hyper-competitive rebounder who can also block shots.
He is a capable scorer with good FG% and FT% and some three-point range. Experts disagree on how far his shooting goes: one says he can shoot threes, another says he can shoot only a little.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 669, ESPN rank 250). The projections give him about 18 minutes, with only 7.7 points and 4.7 rebounds. In our 12-team league he is not a pick in a 144-player draft unless Charlotte names him a starter before the 2026-10-18 auction. If you do take him, he is a 1 USD flyer. Early in the season, watch whether he takes Diabaté's starting spot or gets a center role after an injury, and whether Charlotte lets him shoot threes. With big minutes his rebounds and blocks could make him a waiver add.
